implementation.goal: Explore roughly half the vest triangles for distant actors; error/visual gates take precedence over target count.

Independent skinned multi-pose/multi-view comparison; no new seam gaps, inverted faces, obvious clothing/body intersection or silhouette loss.
Near/far threshold hysteresis, camera reset, source isolation and geometry resource lifetime.

accepted_diagnostic.orientation_gate: Zero opposing triangles against posed authored normals, at eleven recorded poses. Sign test with nonzero normal requirement; not an all-pose intersection proof.
accepted_diagnostic.surface_gate: Seven finite samples per triangle in each direction; maximum observed position error 0.508 mm. Not analytic Hausdorff.
accepted_diagnostic.normal_diagnostic: Nearest-face angles can select the opposite thin sheet/component; retain these measurements as diagnostics, not the winding gate.
accepted_diagnostic.runtime_scope: DEV plus skinCandidate=1 only; frozen rifle pose, no production character replacement.
accepted_diagnostic.switching: At reference vertical FOV 78 degrees: enter at 8m, return below 7m; adjust apparent distance by current camera FOV. Fixed actor scale 1.
accepted_diagnostic.ownership: Shared source attributes; source-owned distinct index geometry retained in disposal resources, independent per-actor mesh assignment.
accepted_diagnostic.performance: Five-bot submitted triangles fall 17.93% low / 18.22% high. GPU timing varied substantially; no FPS acceptance or GPU-speedup claim.

rejected.reason: Two opposing triangles versus authored normals; retained only as a pinned reconstruction seed and rejection evidence.
